name: WiFi QR Generator
summary: Create a Wi‑Fi login QR code (SSID, password, WPA/WEP/open) and download PNG or SVG.
description: Build a standard WIFI: QR payload for WPA/WPA2, WEP, or open networks, including hidden SSIDs. Preview and download PNG/SVG. Generation runs entirely in your browser — credentials are not uploaded.

faqs.question: Will phones recognize this QR?
faqs.answer: Most modern iOS and Android cameras open a “Join network” prompt for WIFI: payloads.

faqs.question: Is my password uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The WIFI: string and QR image are built locally in your browser.

faqs.question: What about special characters in the SSID?
faqs.answer: Characters like ; : , " and \ are escaped per the WIFI QR convention.
